typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ClaimDetlFlatFileConn_AlwaysCheckForRowDelimiters as boolean (),
	ClaimDetl_ConnectionString as string ()
}

source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Master Consumer ID] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Master Consumer ID]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Claim Nbr] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Claim Nbr]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Line Number] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Line Number]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([From Date] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [From Date]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([End Date] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [End Date]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Year] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Year]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Health Service Code] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Health Service Code]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Revenue Code] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Revenue Code]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Health Service Code Modifier] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Health Service Code Modifier]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([# of Service Units] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [# of Service Units]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Line Billed] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Line Billed]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Place of Service] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Place of Service]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Inpatient Flag] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Inpatient Flag]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([International Classification of Diseases Version Code] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [International Classification of Diseases Version Code]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Claim SOR CD] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Claim SOR CD]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Paid service unit count] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Paid service unit count]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Patient Responsibility Amount] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Patient Responsibility Amount]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Line Allowed] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Line Allowed]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Line Paid] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Line Paid]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([IN and OUT of Network claims] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [IN and OUT of Network claims]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Denial_Reason_Code] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Denial_Reason_Code]  ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE([Denial_Reason_Description] ,CHAR(10),\'\')))  AS [Denial_Reason_Description]   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[TX_NAPI_UTSW_CLAIM_LINE]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SrcClaimsDetailTable
SrcClaimsDetailTable sink(input(
		Patient_Responsibility_Amount as string,
		Line_Number as string,
		Line_Paid as string,
		Claim_Nbr as string,
		IN_and_OUT_of_Network_claims as string,
		From_Date as string,
		__of_Service_Units as string,
		Health_Service_Code as string,
		International_Classification_of_Diseases_Version_Code as string,
		End_Date as string,
		Health_Service_Code_Modifier as string,
		Paid_service_unit_count as string,
		Denial_Reason_Code as string,
		Master_Consumer_ID as string,
		Denial_Reason_Description as string,
		Place_of_Service as string,
		Line_Allowed as string,
		Year as string,
		Revenue_Code as string,
		Line_Billed as string,
		Claim_SOR_CD as string,
		Inpatient_Flag as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Patient_Responsibility_Amount = {Patient Responsibility Amount},
		Line_Number = {Line Number},
		Line_Paid = {Line Paid},
		Claim_Nbr = {Claim Nbr},
		IN_and_OUT_of_Network_claims = {IN and OUT of Network claims},
		From_Date = {From Date},
		__of_Service_Units = {# of Service Units},
		Health_Service_Code = {Health Service Code},
		International_Classification_of_Diseases_Version_Code = {International Classification of Diseases Version Code},
		End_Date = {End Date},
		Health_Service_Code_Modifier = {Health Service Code Modifier},
		Paid_service_unit_count = {Paid service unit count},
		Denial_Reason_Code,
		Master_Consumer_ID = {Master Consumer ID},
		Denial_Reason_Description,
		Place_of_Service = {Place of Service},
		Line_Allowed = {Line Allowed},
		Year,
		Revenue_Code = {Revenue Code},
		Line_Billed = {Line Billed},
		Claim_SOR_CD = {Claim SOR CD},
		Inpatient_Flag = {Inpatient Flag})) ~> TgtClaimsDetailFile
